metadata.note: 1987 European, without catalyst. Each bank's three short branches (about 0.10 m, x 43 mm) enter one wide log 118 mm apart, not an equal-length collector: the log is three pipes of 0.12 m x 55 mm, the cylinders entering one by one in turn (cylinders 1-3 left, 4-6 right; firing 1-6-2-4-3-5 alternates the banks). At the log's end each bank's KKK K26 (housing size 6, 6 cm2): its throat 0.08 m x 27.6 mm and a room 0.12 m x 150 mm after it, the one form of every turbine here; the cross tube and the wastegate are not written. From the turbines pipes of about 0.26 and 0.36 m (x 64 mm) to the one transverse oval silencer (about 0.70 m), entering near its ends and leaving from them; how the gas runs within it is not known, and it is written as its body's 0.70 m run through (x 209 mm, 24.0 L, 8.4 times the displacement), with the wool, the one expansion chamber; its two tails as one of their combined area (0.26 m x 90 mm). Lengths and diameters are estimates from eurospares' parts diagrams 202-000, -002 and -005 (about +-20 %). The pipes' diameters are the real car's inner diameters times 1.14, the primaries' included; the expansion chambers' (silencers' bodies') sizes and places, the 1.14 and the 20 mm of wool were set by ear (K, 2026-11-22). Lengths are in steps of 0.02 m. Valve: two exhaust valves per cylinder, 33 mm each (an estimate from the 928 four-valve head whose valve seat the 959 shares), written as one valve of their combined area, 46.7 mm; open about 260 deg (an estimate).
